description: This is a Java source file defining the 'LoanCharge' domain entity within the Fineract project. It models various aspects of a loan charge, including amounts, statuses, relationships to other entities (like loans, charges, installment charges), and business logic related to fee calculation, payment, waiver, and state management.

classes.name: LoanCharge
classes.description: Entity representing a loan charge with detailed properties and business methods managing charge status, calculations, and relationships within the loan accounting context.

methods.name: markAsFullyPaid
methods.description: Marks the charge as fully paid by setting amountPaid to total amount and amountOutstanding to zero.

methods.name: isFullyPaid
methods.description: Returns whether the charge is marked as fully paid.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Reset amounts to their original state, recalculating amountOutstanding based on currency.

methods.name: resetPaidAmount
methods.description: Resets the amountPaid and recalculates amountOutstanding.

methods.name: setOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Sets the amountOutstanding value.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Marks the charge as waived, adjusting amounts accordingly for installments or entire charge.

methods.name: undoWaive
methods.description: Reverses the waived status of the charge.

methods.name: calculateAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates remaining amount outstanding considering paid, waived, and written off amounts.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Associates the charge with a specific loan instance.

methods.name: isDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if the charge is due at loan disbursement or tranche disbursement.

methods.name: isSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks if the charge has a specified due date.

methods.name: isInstalmentFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an installment fee.

methods.name: isOverdueInstallmentCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an overdue installment charge.

methods.name: determineIfFullyPaid
methods.description: Determines if the charge is fully paid based on amount.

methods.name: calculateOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates total remaining amount considering payments and waivers.

methods.name: percentageOf
methods.description: Calculates a percentage of a value based on the charge's percentage.

methods.name: minimumAndMaximumCap
methods.description: Returns the minimum or maximum cap value set on the charge within given limits.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Returns the base amount of the charge.

methods.name: amountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the outstanding amount of the charge.

methods.name: getAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns amount outstanding as Money object for a given currency.

methods.name: hasLoanIdentifiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the loan ID matches the loan associated with the charge.

methods.name: isDueInPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the charge is due within a specified date period.

methods.name: isFeeCharge
methods.description: Checks if this is a fee (non-penalty) charge.

methods.name: isPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Checks if this is a penalty charge.

methods.name: isPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge has been marked as paid.

methods.name: isWaived
methods.description: Checks if the charge has been waived.

methods.name: isPaidOrPartiallyPaid
methods.description: Determines if the charge is paid or partially paid considering waived and written-off amounts.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the charge amount as Money object.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Returns the amount paid as Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Returns the waived amount as Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the written off amount as Money object.

methods.name: updatePaidAmountBy
methods.description: Updates the paid amount by a certain Money value, adjusting payment and outstanding states.

methods.name: amountOrPercentage
methods.description: Returns the amount or percentage value associated with the charge.

methods.name: chargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates total charge amount considering outstanding, paid, waived, and written-off.

methods.name: updateOverdueInstallmentCharge
methods.description: Sets or updates the overdue installment charge linked to this charge.

methods.name: updateLoanTrancheDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Sets or updates the tranche disbursement charge linked to this charge.

methods.name: updateWaivedAmount
methods.description: Calculates and updates the waived and outstanding amounts considering charge type.

methods.name: getTrancheDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Returns the linked tranche disbursement charge.

methods.name: undoPaidOrPartiallyAmountBy
methods.description: Reverses a payment or partial payment, updating paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: getLastPaidOrPartiallyPaidInstallmentLoanCharge
methods.description: Finds the last installment charge that has been paid or partially paid.

methods.name: isDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Checks if this charge is a disbursement charge.

methods.name: isTrancheDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Checks if this charge is a tranche disbursement charge.

methods.name: isDueDateCharge
methods.description: Checks if this charge has a due date.

methods.name: undoWaived
methods.description: Reverts the waived state to false.

methods.name: getChargeTimeType
methods.description: Returns the charge's time type as an enum.

methods.name: getEffectiveDueDate
methods.description: Returns the effective due date, considering installment fee logic.

methods.name: getLoanChargePaidBy
methods.description: Filters the set of LoanChargePaidBy entities based on the provided predicate.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a data transfer object (DTO) for external use.

methods.name: hasInstallmentFor
methods.description: Checks if a specific installment is associated with this charge.
